integrity: The signature criterion and two real factorization orbits are proved over the real numbers. The symbolic verifier checks algebraic identities and sample cases; independent mathematical auditing has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only smooth real quadrics tangent to all four fixed coordinate planes; geometric real line-factor pairs rather than the scheme structure of parameter fibers. Singular limits, higher degrees and arbitrary coordinate systems are not classified. Literature priority is provisional because access to one related 2024 full text was partial.
title: Real Hadamard line decompositions of coordinate-tangent quadrics
